_comment: Skill Forge node palette served by sfInit -> CharacterClass.SkillNodes. Each node is a List<NodeLayout>. ComponentType: 0=InputButton 1=InputField 2=Label 3=Helper 4=Conditional 5=Activator 6=BranchOutput 7=System. ReturnType: 0=String 1=Float 2=Integer 3=Boolean. A header's first element may carry HeaderColor (#rrggbb) on a Label (ComponentType 2, renders nothing). This palette is OURS (AE never replied to sfInit) modelled on the runtime Node* combat executors; server/combat.py is the matching interpreter. Nodes/fields combat understands: Damage(DamageType,Multiplier,Targets), Cooldown(Slot,CD,Animation), Resource(Amount), Range(HRange,VRange,Targets), PlayerAnimation, SoundFX, Particle, Aura(AuraName,Duration,Targets), Restrict(Movement,Skills,Duration,Targets), MoveTargets(Mode,Distance,Targets). Helpers resolve Targets: Self=caster, Target=cast target, AllEnemies=every monster in the area (server-side AoE).

OnRequest.Name: _header
OnRequest.Tooltip: Skill entry point — execution begins here.

Range.Name: HRange
Range.Tooltip: Horizontal reach used to find targets.

Range.Name: VRange
Range.Tooltip: Vertical reach used to find targets.

Damage.Name: Multiplier
Damage.Tooltip: Damage as a multiple of a normal hit. Leave blank for normal (1x).

Damage.Name: Targets
Damage.Tooltip: Which targets take the damage (wire a Self / Target / AllEnemies helper).

Aura.Name: Duration
Aura.Tooltip: How long the aura lasts, in seconds.

MoveTargets.Name: Mode
MoveTargets.Tooltip: Pull targets toward you or push them away.

MoveTargets.Name: Distance
MoveTargets.Tooltip: How far to move the targets.

AnimationHitbox.Name: X
AnimationHitbox.Tooltip: Hitbox centre X offset from the caster.

AnimationHitbox.Name: Animation
AnimationHitbox.Tooltip: Animation the hitbox is tied to.

AnimationHitbox.Name: Time
AnimationHitbox.Tooltip: When in the animation the hitbox fires (seconds).

AnimationHitbox.Name: Targets
AnimationHitbox.Tooltip: Entities the client reports the swing hit (resolved via igai/gai).

Hitbox.Name: Targets
Hitbox.Tooltip: Entities the client reports inside the box (igai/gai).

Resource.Name: Amount
Resource.Tooltip: Resource (RP/mana) value set after the skill.

Cooldown.Name: Slot
Cooldown.Tooltip: Skill slot to put on cooldown (1-based in editor). Leave blank for this skill's slot.

Cooldown.Name: Animation
Cooldown.Tooltip: Animation event that starts the cooldown (blank = immediate).

Interruptable.Name: Value
Interruptable.Tooltip: Whether the skill can be interrupted while casting.
